guidance.heading: Guidance
section:
Q4'26 | 2026
Gross Profit | $3.315B | Gross Profit | $12.626B
YoY Growth | 15% | YoY Growth | 22%
Adjusted Operating Income | $1.005B | Adjusted Operating Income | $3.519B
% Margin | 30% | % Margin | 28%
Rule of X17 | 46% | Rule of X | 50%
Adjusted Diluted EPS | $1.15 | Adjusted Diluted EPS | $4.15
YoY Growth | 77% | YoY Growth | 75%

We are raising our full-year guidance to reflect the momentum we are seeing across Block. For 2026, we now expect $12.626 billion in gross profit, up 22% year over year, and Adjusted Operating Income of $3.519 billion, or 28% margin, growing 69% year over year. We also expect Adjusted Diluted EPS to grow 75% to $4.15.

17 Rule of 40 is the sum of our gross profit growth and Adjusted Operating Income margin as a percent of gross profit. We may refer to a “Rule of” number other than 40 to refer to the sum of gross profit growth and Adjusted Operating Income margin as a percent of gross profit for the period given.
